W A S D or arrows to drive · S is normal braking, Space is the emergency brake (handbrake in cars) · E doors · C camera · Q radio · M map · H horn · B bell · R reset · P pause · Drag to look around

Xbox controller: RT gas · LT brake and reverse · left stick steer · right stick look · A doors · B horn · X bell · Y camera (chase, on top of the car, driver seat, trackside) · LB and RB radio · View map · Menu pause

Free drive: E or F use item · G get out, get in, or take a vehicle · R back to the street · Xbox: A use item · X get out or take a vehicle · LB handbrake · Player 2 keyboard: Enter item · / get out
